source: PC Night of the Hunter: the dog whistle is an inventory item from the hall's chest of drawers, used from the kitchen while the neighbour is at the record player (Steam guide 2584421942; Badinfos' run, lap 2). The mobile has no whistle — its Dog is a Zone06 Alerter. PC thermometer (tools/pcref/thermo.py): the mercury jumps to full on every trick, holds while the angry plays and drains to empty in 12.0 s in Badinfos' E14 — PCThermometerDrain 8.3 %/s, the HUD's drawing rate only; the tick meter keeps the data's AngryMeterDecay 4.23 (docs/PC_FIDELITY.md §7).

InventoryItems.DescriptionString: Only the dog hears it. The neighbour hears the dog.
